subject: Slack scheduled-task processing integrated; BF-ENH-0004 awaiting review
body: By explicit human directive, Slack is now an approved secondary scheduled-task coordination surface for BenefitFlow. The repository/AgentBus remains authoritative: material Slack task results must be persisted into BenefitFlow before becoming durable project state, and Slack may not bypass P0 or human approval gates. The BenefitFlow Scheduled Task Queue (Slack List F0C6J84HJR0) currently tracks the pending R7/R10 reconciliation, recursive enhancement cycles, and BF-ENH-0004. Succession revalidation found Duo Open unchanged and Intercommunications Enhancements advanced from 707865e0 to a0799ffc with a new executable local-only recursive enhancement engine. BF-ENH-0004 captures that as an ADAPT_REQUIRED candidate. Managers should review whether BenefitFlow should graft an executable enforcement helper plus tests or retain protocol-only enforcement. R7/R10 reconciliation remains the higher-priority pending cross-lane disposition and its P0 constraints remain unchanged.
